note: THE CONTENT DOCUMENT, EMPTY. This is the slot the course goes in: one document, loaded through src/lib/contentLoader.js and checked by src/lib/contentSchema.js, so adding the course is a data change here rather than a code change anywhere. It held four modules of placeholder material — general-knowledge quizzes, Blender open movies, invented notes and threads — which shipped as a lazy chunk every visitor could still be served. That came out for the beta: `npm run check:ship` is the gate that was failing on it, and `git log -- src/content/test-content.json` is where the old set lives if it is ever wanted back. Modules themselves are named in src/data.js; this document is what fills them.
contentModel: modules[] -> chapters[] -> lessons[] and one quiz per chapter. notes, threads, replies, people and presence are the lesson surface's own rows. See contentSchema.js for the exact shape and the validator that enforces it.
